title: 第二章 对傻子下手！
content_zh:
王大壮站着没动，他个子高，肩膀宽，像一堵墙似的。

    李玉梅撞上去的时候，下意识地抓住了王大壮的胳膊，那胳膊硬邦邦的，全是结实的肌肉。

    一股浓烈的汗味钻进她的鼻子里，不是那种让人作呕的酸臭，而是一种带着原始的雄性荷尔蒙的气息。

    李玉梅的心忽然跳了一下，说不清是什么感觉，只是觉得莫名地踏实。

    她在这个村子里待了五年，独守了五年空房，已经有很久很久没有感受过一个男人身体的温度了。

    “嘿嘿，嫂子吓尿了。”王大壮的声音从头顶传来，还是那种没心没肺的傻笑。

    李玉梅猛地回过神来，意识到自己正紧紧抓着这个傻子的胳膊，姿态实在是不太得体。

    她像是被烫着了一样松开手，往后退了一步，脸上的红晕一直蔓延到了脖子根。

    “胡说什么！”她啐了一口，声音却不自觉地有些发虚。

    她低着头不敢看王大壮，心口还在砰砰地跳。

    余光扫过王大壮的身躯——人高马大，肩宽背阔，虽然穿着破破烂烂的衣服，可那身形却掩盖不住，硬朗得很。

    胸前的衣服敞开着，露出里面结实的肌肉线条，被汗水浸润着，在昏暗的光线下泛着一层微微的光泽。

    李玉梅的心又跳了一下。

    她抬起头，终于正眼看了王大壮一眼。

    这个傻子，平日里只觉得他傻，倒没注意过他的长相。

    此刻仔细一看，五官其实生得不差，浓眉大眼，鼻梁挺直，下巴方正，如果脑子没坏的话，大概也是个精神的小伙子。

    只是那双眼睛里没有正常人该有的精明和算计，干干净净的，像山涧里的泉水，一眼就能看到底。

    轰隆隆——

    又一阵雷声滚过，天色更暗了，风也更大了，树枝被吹得哗啦啦响，有几滴雨落下来，打在树叶上噼啪作响。

    “快下雨了，赶紧下山。”李玉梅收起乱七八糟的心思，对王大壮说道：“淋了雨要感冒的。”

    王大壮却摇了摇头，一脸认真道：“不行，我想抓到野鸡给嫂子补补身子。”

    李玉梅愣了一下，想说什么，可看着他那副固执的样子，知道跟他说不通。

    傻子认准了的事情，九头牛都拉不回来。

    就在这时候，雨忽然就下来了。
content_en:
Wang Dazhuang stood still. He was tall and had broad shoulders, like a wall.

    When Li Youmei bumped into him, she subconsciously grabbed Wang Dazhuang's arm. The arm was hard and full of strong muscles.

    A strong smell of sweat penetrated her nose. It was not the disgusting sour smell, but a smell of raw male hormones.

    Li Youmei's heart suddenly jumped. She couldn't explain what she felt, but she just felt inexplicably at ease.

    She had stayed in this village for five years and stayed alone in an empty house for five years. It had been a long, long time since she had felt the warmth of a man's body.

    "Hey, sister-in-law is scared to death." Wang Dazhuang's voice came from above his head, still with that heartless giggle.

    Li Youmei suddenly came to her senses and realized that she was holding this fool's arm tightly, and her posture was really not very appropriate.

    She let go of her hand as if she had been burned and took a step back. The blush on her face spread to the root of her neck.

    "What nonsense!" She spat, but her voice was unconsciously weak.

    She lowered her head and didn't dare to look at Wang Dazhuang, her heart still pounding.

    The peripheral vision swept across Wang Dazhuang's body - he was tall, broad-shouldered and broad-backed. Although he was wearing tattered clothes, his figure could not be concealed and he was very tough.

    The clothes on the chest were open, revealing the strong muscle lines underneath, which were soaked with sweat and had a slight sheen under the dim light.

    Li Youmei's heart jumped again.

    She raised her head and finally took a look at Wang Dazhuang.

    This fool, I only thought he was stupid, but didn't pay attention to his appearance.

    Now if I take a closer look, I can see that his facial features are actually pretty good, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, a straight bridge of nose, and a square chin. If his brain is not bad, he is probably a energetic young man.

    It's just that those eyes don't have the shrewdness and calculation that normal people should have. They are as clean as spring water in a mountain stream, and you can see the bottom at a glance.

    Rumble——

    Another burst of thunder rolled past, the sky became darker, the wind became stronger, the branches were blown loudly, and a few drops of rain fell, crackling on the leaves.

    "It's going to rain. Come down the mountain quickly." Li Youmei put away all her thoughts and said to Wang Dazhuang, "You'll catch a cold if you get caught in the rain."

    Wang Dazhuang shook his head and said seriously: "No, I want to catch pheasants to replenish my sister-in-law's health."

    Li Youmei was stunned for a moment and wanted to say something, but looking at his stubborn look, she knew she couldn't explain it to him.

    Even nine cows can't pull back what a fool sees for sure.

    At this moment, the rain suddenly fell.
